insight: Multer fileFilter only checks client-supplied file.mimetype (ALLOWED_MIME set), does not validate file extension. safeName preserves original extension. express.static serves files with Content-Type from extension. An evil.html with Content-Type: image/jpeg passes and is served as text/html. Always check both MIME and extension.

Founder built extensive multi-feature platform (EduAI) with no real users. Said "all of this" twice when asked for specific user/feature. Classic pattern: product thinking substituted for sales thinking. Correct move: identify narrowest wedge (AI test generator for JEE/NEET coaching centers), validate with one real conversation before next feature.

Gemini Flash supports native PDF input via inlineData (base64 + mimeType: application/pdf) — no pdf-parse needed. Handles scanned PDFs via vision. Use multer.memoryStorage() for ephemeral PDF processing; disk storage accumulates files with no cleanup.

Founder submitted a 150-line technical requirements document (HRD) for an agent orchestration platform with zero demand evidence. The HRD was excellent as a technology survey but had no customer, no differentiation story, and no wedge. Pattern: deep technical research substitutes for demand validation. The HRD is a Phase 3 artifact, not a Phase 0 artifact — you should not be writing architecture before you have 3 customer conversations. Fixed by adding: premise challenge on differentiation, CommitGuard as wedge, and assignment to find 3 developers before writing code.

firebase-auth-dialog.tsx used bg-eduai-primary/hover:bg-eduai-accent which are undefined in tailwind.config.ts (theme has primary/accent/accent-hover/eduaccent, no eduai-*). Undefined Tailwind color classes fail silently -> transparent bg, invisible buttons. Grep eduai- after any color-token rename.

Tenant scoping written as `if (admin.schoolCode && role!=admin)` fails OPEN: self-signup creates school_admin with null schoolCode, so the filter is skipped and queries return all schools. Gate on role first, then require schoolCode (403 if missing).

Self-signup onboarding (server/routes/onboarding.ts:194) links the user to the new school via schoolId only, but the tenant guard (server/lib/tenant.ts) authorizes on schoolCode. Result: brand-new schools get NULL school_code and every school-scoped API (attendance/fees/admin-stats/students) returns 403 fail-closed. schoolId linkage is never used for access control.

npm run migrate fails against docker/docker-compose.dev.yml Postgres because postgres:16-alpine lacks pgvector (scripts/pg-schema.sql:7 CREATE EXTENSION vector; also vector(1536) col + ivfflat index at lines 879/888). To seed dev schema, apply a copy of pg-schema.sql with those 3 vector lines neutralized. Also start the pg + redis containers first or the API 503s on every route.

Express/Vite catch-all serves index.html with HTTP 200 for ANY unmatched /api/* path. This masked two dead features: client posts /api/classes but the handler is mounted at /api/onboarding/classes (server/routes.ts:93), so teacher class creation silently no-ops while the UI and quest tracker report success. Grep for apiRequest paths vs router mounts when a flow succeeds in UI but writes nothing.

authenticateToken (server/middleware.ts:50) builds req.user without schoolCode even though it fetched the full user row, so resolveTenantScope 403s every attendance/fees request for ALL school roles regardless of correct DB linkage. Two independent bugs give the same 403: onboarding never sets school_code (routes/onboarding.ts:194 sets schoolId only) AND middleware strips it.

Fabricated demo data is not one toggle: (a) client state defaulting demo-ON (client/src/pages/principal-dashboard.tsx:46 useState(true)), (b) server ?demo=true params (server/routes/analytics.ts:405,515), (c) hardcoded data||mockData fallbacks that ignore any toggle (performance-chart.tsx:39, top-students.tsx). Fallbacks must be deleted, not toggled. No CLASSMODE-DEMO school-code constant exists in code; gate on an is_demo boolean on schools.

GET /api/dashboards/student in server/routes/analytics.ts hardcoded xp:450/level:12/streak:6 in the JSON response — there is no XP/streak/level column in the users table, so any gamification UI shows fabricated values to real accounts. Return 0/1/0 until a real XP system exists.

client/src/App.tsx mounted @/components/ui/toaster (Radix) but NOT sonner Toaster, yet cta.tsx and dynamic-sis/DataGrid.tsx call toast from "sonner". sonner toast() calls silently no-op (no error) when no <Toaster/> from sonner is rendered. Fixed by adding <SonnerToaster/> in App.tsx root. Grep for imports from "sonner" and confirm a sonner Toaster is mounted.

t(key, fallback) in client/src/lib/i18n.tsx returns the dictionary value whenever the key exists, so rewriting copy only in the fallback argument silently no-ops — the old dictionary string keeps rendering (landing.tagline kept showing the pre-rework tagline). When changing t() fallback copy, always update or delete the dictionary entry too.

The Claude Preview browser tab reports visibilityState=hidden and requestAnimationFrame never fires, so framer-motion mount animations freeze at their initial inline styles (opacity:0) — pages look broken/dimmed in preview screenshots when they are fine in real browsers. Verify animation-dependent UI with Playwright (rAF fires there), and treat stuck-at-initial framer styles in preview as an environment artifact, not a product bug.

server/lib/prompt-loader.ts reads server/lib/prompts/study-arena/* from disk at runtime (process.cwd()-relative); anything the server reads at runtime must be explicitly COPYd into the final Docker stage (docker/Dockerfile) alongside dist/ and pg-schema.sql — dist bundling does NOT include these. Broke all AI classroom generation in prod with template-not-found.

Classroom-generation provider order: gemini first, openai last (server/services/study-arena/generator.ts:300).

pgMarkAttendance (server/lib/pg-queries.ts:2643) is client-clock last-write-wins with silently swallowed conflict rows (returns deduped.length regardless of skips) and all-or-nothing batch semantics; any offline/conflict work requires the E9 rewrite (version column, batch UUID, per-row outcomes) recorded in the 2026-07-15 CEO plan. Also: user.school_code vs schoolCode mismatch at routes/attendance.ts:115 NULLs admin writes.

Percentage-of-baseline alert thresholds are permanently disarmed when the committed baseline week is all zeros (0*0.5=0 can never be breached); anchor baselines on the first period with real activity and warn loudly while unarmed

Invite LIST endpoints leaked the redeemable token (SELECT * + mapInvite), and the unauthenticated /invite/accept overwrites an EXISTING account by email (password, role, school) — together an account-takeover chain any teacher could drive via student invites. Fixed 2026-07-18: serializeInviteForList strips tokens on both list routes, accept refuses to clobber privileged accounts. Residual: non-privileged overwrite semantics + mailbox-proof, tracked in TODOS.

WHATSAPP_ALERTS_ENABLED gated only the absence-alert dispatch; the hourly scheduleAtRiskChecks automation pipeline (inactivity/low-score parent nudges) ran on Redis+Meta creds alone, able to silently break the pilot no-auto-send guarantee. Any master no-send switch must gate EVERY enqueue path, not just the request-driven one. Gated at scheduler entry + boot 2026-07-18 with regression test.

study-arena-beta messageForError mapped 401/403/429/>=500 and let every other status fall through to "Couldn't reach the lesson service. Check your connection" — so a 400 from the route's zod caps (topic 300, question 2000, answer 4000) blamed the student's wifi for a validation failure and created an unbreakable retry loop. Worst mid-lesson: a >4000-char answer at a gate could never be submitted. Any status-to-copy mapper needs an explicit 4xx branch; a catch-all network message is a lie for every 4xx.

To QA Study Arena locally you need three things, and two of them bite. (1) Postgres: DOCKER_HOST=ssh://wednesday devdb up — there is no local docker daemon, wednesday is a Windows host so ssh commands must be quoted as a single arg. (2) A student account: scripts/seed-e2e-test-accounts.ts seeds admin+teacher ONLY, but 5 student rows already exist in devdb — set a known bcrypt password on one instead of creating another. (3) STUDY_ARENA_BETA needs no setting: it defaults ON when NODE_ENV!==production. Confirm with GET /api/study-arena-beta/health. /logout is not a route (SPA 404s to 200); use POST /api/auth/logout to switch users.

node-postgres returns bigint columns as JS strings, so strict comparisons like row.student_id !== userId are always true. This codebase wraps them in Number() (assignment-sessions.ts:197, study-arena-beta.ts workspace_id/created_by) but five sites in assignment-sessions.ts had missed it, 403ing every student. Unit tests did not catch it because fixtures set student_id as a number, which the driver never returns. When testing pg row handling, fixture bigint columns as STRINGS.

POSTGRESQL_URL in .env points at 192.168.50.2:5433 which times out; use local classmode_qa (postgresql://friday@127.0.0.1:5432/classmode_qa) plus npm run migrate. npm run dev runs tsx WITHOUT watch so server edits need a restart (client hot-reloads via vite). Seeded pilot students have no usable password; only principal@pilot.test / PilotPassword123! works. Teacher routes need a workspace_memberships row or they 409 No active workspace.

Postgres cannot infer a parameter type when the same $n appears bare in an assignment AND inside CASE WHEN $n IS NULL, failing with 42P08 could not determine data type. Cast every occurrence ($n::text). Hit in the study-arena scene-cursor UPDATE, where a bare catch{} hid the real error behind a generic 500.

wouter v3 useLocation() returns the PATHNAME ONLY — it never contains the query string. Patterns like location.split("?")[1] silently yield undefined, so the page reads a null param and renders its empty state forever with no error anywhere. Use useSearch() (reactive) or window.location.search. In this repo accept-invite.tsx is the correct reference; study-arena-report.tsx had the broken pattern.

In Class Mode school_admin is the TENANT admin (school owner) and admin is the PLATFORM super-role allowed cross-school reads (server/lib/auth/tenant.ts); principal is a third distinct role. Role lists that say [teacher, admin] silently exclude the person actually running the school. House convention for staff surfaces is [admin, principal, school_admin], plus teacher where teaching applies. When fixing role gating here, fix BOTH the client protect() list in App.tsx AND the server-side check, or the page loads and then 403s.

Number(pgBigint) !== jsNumber is the house idiom in Class Mode for id comparisons, but it silently collapses distinct ids above 2^53-1. Unreachable in practice here (needs 9 quadrillion users) so not worth a piecemeal fix, but if bigint ids ever come from an external source or a high-start sequence, switch ALL id comparisons to string compare at once. Codex adversarial flagged this during /ship 2026-08-07.

gstack ship Step 20 writes ~/.gstack/projects/$SLUG/$BRANCH-reviews.jsonl. Branch names containing a slash (cursor/foo, feat/bar) make that a nested path and the append fails with no such file or directory. Sanitize with tr / - before the redirect. Same trap applies to any gstack artifact path keyed on branch.

When a feature lands on main via squash-merge, a long-lived branch holding the same work hits add/add conflicts on every shared file even though nothing diverged. Before resolving, diff origin/main against the branch pre-fix baseline per file: if byte-identical, the conflict is pure ancestry noise and checkout --ours is safe and loses nothing. Verify each resolved file against the pre-merge HEAD afterwards.

server/lib/db/pg-queries.ts converts DB read failures into successful-looking empty results in 70 of 79 catch blocks (e.g. pgGetAttendanceByClassDate:2756 logs and returns []). Routes then serve HTTP 200 with [], so any client that does not check an error renders a plausible empty state. attendance.tsx:86 is the live instance: the saved-attendance query destructures neither isLoading nor error, so a failed read shows an empty EDITABLE register for a day already recorded. Fix the server layer first; a client-side error check cannot detect an error the server never reports.

The /autoplan Implementation Tasks aggregator silently returns zero tasks. Its jq filter is select(... ($commits | split("|") | index(.commit) != null)) — inside that pipe . is the split ARRAY, not the task object, so jq errors with Cannot index array with string, and the snippet pipes stderr to /dev/null. Fix: bind the row first, e.g. . as $r | select($r.branch == $branch and (($commits|split("|")|index($r.commit)) != null)).

Fixing an unreachable page can expose broken controls behind it. /study-arena-report was stuck on its empty state (wouter useLocation has no query string), so nobody noticed its Open learner view button links to /study-arena-beta?assignment=..., which POSTs /assignment-session — a route that rejects any role except student. Every role able to reach the report got a 403. When a fix makes a page reachable for the first time, adversarially review every control ON that page, not just the fix.

npm audit has no native per-advisory ignore. To keep a --audit-level=high gate meaningful while excluding an unfixable advisory, run `npm audit --json --omit=dev` and filter with jq on the GHSA id parsed from .vulnerabilities[].via[].url, failing when any non-allowlisted high/critical remains. Verify the filter with negative tests (empty allowlist must fail; allowlisting one of two advisories on the same package must still fail) or you can silently disable the whole gate. jq is preinstalled on ubuntu-latest runners.

The gstack browse daemon accumulates console output across navigations, so reading `console --errors` after several `goto` calls returns a running total, not per-page counts (observed 18/23/26/29 across four pages that each actually had 3). Per-page measurement requires `console --clear` then `goto` then `wait --networkidle` before reading. Also: reading `text` without waiting for network idle catches the SPA shell pre-hydration (131 bytes instead of 5452). And `snapshot -o` writes an accessibility tree, not an image — use `screenshot -o` for a PNG.

A fixed-position onboarding overlay can make a core workflow physically unusable without producing any console error, failing test, or visual glitch in a desktop screenshot taken at the wrong scroll position. Class Mode QuestPanel (fixed bottom-20 right-4 w-80 z-72) blocked 6 of 7 attendance status buttons at 1280x800 and, being fixed, followed the scroll on mobile. Detect this class of bug with document.elementFromPoint at each control centre rather than by looking at screenshots; bound the check to the viewport or off-screen elements return null and inflate the count.
